description: Get US federal per diem rates (government travel lodging and meal allowances) for a city by name and state. Returns the monthly lodging ceiling (per-diem lodging varies by month/season), the flat M&IE (meals & incidental expenses) daily total, and its breakdown into breakfast, lunch, dinner, incidental expenses and the first/last travel day amount (meals_breakdown). Answers "GSA FY2026 M&IE breakdown for Nashville, TN", "federal per diem for Denver, CO", "government hotel rate cap in San Francisco". Example: rates_by_city({ city: "Denver", state: "CO" }).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own api.data.gov / GSA API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

year.description: Fiscal/rate year, e.g. 2026. Defaults to the current year.

name: rates_by_city
title: Rates By City
